2_a_conditional_compressor_path_cannot_c.cost: 128 output columns each, replicated on 8 nodes; HBM still fits with 52 GB spare
2_a_conditional_compressor_path_cannot_c.refusal_it_removes: kernel main.layer02.attention.indexer.key_project: a rolling-compressor conditional path cannot also carry link class 'activation_transfer'
2_a_conditional_compressor_path_cannot_c.stated_twice_on_purpose: compiler/backends/hbm_sram/plan.py decides it and compiler/backends/hbm_sram/check.py re-derives it from the graph.  The checker must not read the planner's answer, so it reads the same kernel attributes the lowering uses to find the path at all.
2_a_conditional_compressor_path_cannot_c.why_replication: A rolling compressor's conditional path carries two guarded physical instructions -- the prefill-many form and the boundary-decode-one form -- that converge only after the compressed-cache append, and neither is the place to put one all-gather of a result the other did not produce.  Replication is what this planner already does with a contraction a node count cannot cut, so it is what a conditional path gets.

remaining_refusals.refusal: program signals 2442 distinct events, capability admits 2048
remaining_refusals.why: 2,048 is the largest event board the implemented hardware expresses: rtl/abi3/ot_a3_event_scoreboard.sv follows ot_a3_pkg.sv's A3_EVENT_COUNT = 2048 and its index width follows that.  The two V4.1 ROM records already publish that number and reach it with margin (1,490 and 1,544 events).  The shipped release at eight nodes needs 2,442, so this is not fixable by widening a record -- it needs either event recycling in the lowering or a wider scoreboard in RTL with the microsequencer re-qualified.

remaining_refusals.refusal: checker: kernel main.layer{02,14}.attention.indexer.key_project weight has the wrong NODE_ID selection for its reconstructed physical materialization
remaining_refusals.why: The planner now replicates a contraction on a rolling compressor's conditional path and the independent checker restates the same rule from the graph, so the two agree.  Before, the planner replicated and the checker's own geometry reconstruction still expected a node selection.
